purpose: Generic action-boundary cue retrieval for public MCP read packets. Project-specific commands and publication targets belong in governed project laws, not in this universal spec.

boundary_action.title: Boundary action
boundary_action.summary: An action that may cross a workflow, publication, external system, or handoff boundary.

external_publication.title: External publication
external_publication.summary: An action that updates externally visible artifacts, release surfaces, or published operator-facing resources.

release_boundary.title: Release boundary
release_boundary.summary: An action that moves work from internal implementation into a released or externally consumable state.

operator_handoff.title: Operator handoff
operator_handoff.summary: An action where responsibility, review, or execution context passes to a human/operator or another agent.

next_safe_action: Review compact governed-law cues for this boundary action; expand only refs that are needed before proceeding.
